name: mainline_source_policy_holdout_v1
source_protocol: Two existing d50 families share64 physical policies, each with3 raw episodes. A single label-free permutation partitions physical policies into4 groups of16, shared across families. Each fit uses the other48 policies per family; every response-dependent encoder, basis, units, covariance, discrepancy, evidence and GP fit is rerun on that subset with existing settings and1024 nodes.
adaptation: Within each held group the first2 policy IDs are fixed anchors. Observe only the first f raw of anchor1 then anchor2, giving2 rounds. The other14 policies remain unobserved. Source identity weights include training f/g evidence; held g is never used, isolating objective propagation.
conditioning: These are missing policies of an existing source task. Condition common plus that family's task effect on training raw once. Include task covariance only in same-family query/source cross terms. Retain source eta nodes/weights; do not use the independent new-task projection or replay training raw.
controls: Full objective propagation versus point-only from round0. For point-only, all14 scoring means stay at round0; anchor1 keeps its own round1 posterior mean through round2. Both use the same observed f raw. No alternative covariance, representation or risk model is screened.
scoring: Freeze all fold forecasts before scoring. Each scoring reference is its3-raw f mean. Relative objective differences use anchor1's other2 raw episodes, independent of its update raw. Report absolute and relative MSE, bias, direction agreement and saved observation variance at rounds0/1/2. Primary unit is source family (2); folds and policies are dependent. This is source-policy validation, not unseen-family/generalization or deployment evidence.
checks: Verify physical-policy partition and training-only dimensions. Reconstructed source common moments and node weights must match original fit before same-task projection. A synthetic joint Gaussian test distinguishes same-task from other-task covariance and catches double-counting task variance. Failure stops that fold, with its cost retained.
decision_boundary: Interpret this fixed diagnostic before proposing one source-supported correction. Do not select parameters from1672/1675 target outcomes or from repeated holdout trials. The deployed d1000 model remains frozen. Any future decision-benefit claim requires fresh geometries and matched budgets with full, point-only, same-source GP and legacy references.

outcome.conclusion: Limited source-policy MSE improvement, inconsistent across the two families; no new relative signs or scoring-pool choices. No correction selected.

next_step: Freeze the current d1000 role model and stage31 six-arm protocol. Register a whole fresh-geometry batch before observations, retain original online365/STOP362 budgets and verifier, and compare verified policy quality without outcome-dependent task selection or batch resizing.
